description: Always order movement records by the physical timestamp 变盘时间 ascending. The earliest record is the opening snapshot and the latest record before kickoff is the latest snapshot. Never infer order from row position or from the word 初/即.
scope: All 欧指变盘, 亚盘变盘, and 大小球变盘 reads.

description: An empty market is valid only when the source explicitly says it is not offered. Record it as not_offered; never fabricate a placeholder row or promote it to supported.
scope: All endpoint and bookmaker status reads.

description: The analytical database exposes exactly seven final SQLite tables and zero views. Do not use staging tables, raw JSON, Markdown match files, or a second database as analysis input.
scope: All football match reads in this workspace.

description: The bookmaker status block contains 22 database slots, including 188Bet and China Sports Lottery. Polymarket is a delivery-only reference and must not be invented as a 23rd database bookmaker row.
scope: 欧指, 亚盘, 大小球, and 机构状态.

description: Never fill a missing odd, line, timestamp, team, or status by estimation or fabrication. Missing data stays an explicit gap or not_offered state.
scope: All seven tables and all downstream reads.

description: The data-status block must expose 27 rows across 27 distinct analysis endpoints. A smaller set means the capture is incomplete and must not be treated as a complete match database.
scope: 球队基本情况 data-status reads.
